summary.text: A rift valley is a long, straight lowland lying between highlands or mountain ranges, created by a geologic rift.
Rifts form where the lithosphere is being pulled apart, and the trough that results can be deepened by erosion and filled with sediment from the land around it.
The most extensive rift valley runs along the crest of the mid-ocean ridge system, and many of the world's largest lakes, such as Lake Baikal, sit in rift valleys.

facts.label: Most extensive one
facts.value: Along the crest of the mid-ocean ridges

facts.value: East African, Rio Grande and Baikal

facts.value: Lake Baikal, in an active rift valley

items.prompt: Forces inside the Earth slowly pull two parts of a continent away from each other. What landform tends to open up between them?

options.label: A tall chain of folded peaks

items.explain: Pulling the lithosphere apart creates a rift, and a rift produces a long, linear lowland between the higher ground on either side.

items.prompt: Lake Baikal in Siberia sits in an active rift. Roughly what share of all the liquid freshwater on Earth does it hold?
items.explain: Baikal holds about a fifth of Earth's liquid freshwater, giving it the greatest volume of any lake as well as the greatest depth.

items.prompt: A continental rift such as the East African Rift keeps widening for a very long time. What is it expected to turn into?

options.label: An oceanic rift, like those at sea
A closed-up seam that heals over

items.explain: In active continental rifts whole plates are breaking apart into new plates, and if this continues the continental rift eventually becomes an oceanic rift.

items.prompt: Where on Earth does the most extensive rift valley lie?
items.explain: The biggest rift valley follows the crest of the mid-ocean ridge system, where sea floor spreading pulls the crust apart.

items.prompt: Two blocks of crust slide sideways past each other along a fault that has a bend in it. When does the ground at the bend stretch and sink?

options.label: When the bend turns the same way as the sliding motion
When the bend turns against the direction of sliding
Only when the two blocks stop sliding altogether
Whenever the bend is perfectly straight and even

items.explain: If a bend in a sideways-moving fault points the same way as the motion, the crust there is stretched and drops down, forming a rift valley.

items.prompt: A rift valley has formed between two highlands. What usually happens to its floor over a long stretch of time?

options.label: It is pushed up into a new ridge
It fills with sediment from nearby land
It stays bare rock with nothing on it
It is buried under fresh glacier ice

items.explain: The valley is likely to collect sedimentary deposits washed in from its sides and the surrounding areas, while erosion can deepen it further.
